messages.subject: Re: Data Tuesday Barcelona
messages.body_plain:
Hola R users,

L'organitzador dels Data Tuesday Barcelona ens ha escrit explicant en que consisteix per si hi volem anar. Tot i que de moment no sabem quin perfil va a la reunió intentarem que algú vagi a explicar les bondats de l'R.

> Hi,
> I'm the organizer of Data Tuesday Barcelona, this is a monthly networking event for people interested in "data":
> - Big Data
> - Open Data
> - Data Visualization and Data Journalism.
>
> I believe that R users might be interested by this and incidentaly there still are "Data" people who do know know the wast powers of R :-)
>
> The first "launch meeting" is on the 23rd of July and the second meeting (focusing on data visualization) will be on the 24 th of september.
> This is a free meeting, the model is :
>
> we start around 7:30 pm, have 5 to 10 very short "pitches" about :
> - Projects
> - tools
> - policies
> After 60 to 90 minutes (did I mention that the pitches are short :-)) the assistance can connect with the speakers and discuss in more details about whatever interest them
>
> We got free beer & bretzels.
>
> I hope you would find this interesting, and will circulate it within your group, and would personally be thrilled if one of you would be willing to make a very short introduction into the marvels of R.
> It could be anything that fits into 5 to 10 minutes: either a "layman's" introduction or let's flabbergast and awe the public and explain how R + a cheap GPU can look at thousands of elements and extract "anomalies" in "real time"
> (something like this : http://www.r-tutor.com/gpu-computing/clustering/distance-matrix).
>
> If you are interested the registration page is http://www.meetup.com/Data-Tuesday-Barcelona and we have a web site (currently in English but hopefully we'll be fixing this in a couple of hours) www.data-tuesday.es <http://www.data-tuesday.es/>
>
> nb: the pitch can be in english, spanish or catalan.
>
>   Best Regards
>      Patrick Sinz

ps: sorry for the short head's up, I only today became aware of the fact that there was an R user group in BCN...

Lluís Ramon
